title: Quadratic Parameter Variant Bank
whatYouGet: A parameter-controlled quadratic bank covering factorable, repeated, irrational and complex-root cases deliberately.
howToUse: Set the desired root cases and coefficient bounds, then check the discriminant ledger before assigning items.
effectiveUsage: 1. Choose the root-type mix and coefficient range.
2. Review the discriminant and root ledger.
3. Remove any duplicate or accidental edge case.
4. Release variants in conceptual order with the checked key withheld.
commonFix: If wrong, reply with: "Regenerate coefficients from the requested discriminant classes and verify every root in the original equation."
promptText:
ROLE: Act as a quadratic-case designer and discriminant audit specialist.

CONTEXT: A [CLASS] teacher wants [ITEM COUNT] fresh quadratics spanning [ROOT TYPE MIX].

INPUTS — FILL EVERY PLACEHOLDER:
- [CLASS]
- [ITEM COUNT]
- [ROOT TYPE MIX]
- [COEFFICIENT BOUNDS]
- [METHOD FOCUS]
- [FORBIDDEN FORMS]

SOURCE-BOUND TOOL FACTS AND EXACT URL WHITELIST:
- [WOLFRAMALPHA] Whitelist: https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i={ENCODED_PLAIN_CALCULATOR_QUERY}. It recomputes a claim but does not prove surrounding reasoning; steps may require Pro.
- [SYMBOLAB] Whitelist: https://www.symbolab.com/solver?query={ENCODED_PLAIN_CALCULATOR_QUERY}. Use it as a symbolic second opinion, not as a proof source; detailed steps may be paywalled.

DO THIS:
1. Translate the requested root mix into discriminant and coefficient constraints.
2. Generate coefficient tuples that obey bounds and avoid scalar duplicates.
3. Compute discriminant, exact roots and admissible method for each item.
4. Verify roots by substitution and an independent solver query.
5. Order items to foreground conceptual contrast rather than coefficient size alone.
6. Return a ledger so the teacher can rebalance cases without regenerating everything.

WORKED LINK EXAMPLE — COPY THIS EXACT ENCODING PATTERN:
Example task: Classify and solve x^2-5x+6=0 as a factorable case.
Expected result or check target: Its discriminant is 1 and its distinct integer roots are 2 and 3.
check this yourself
CHECK → https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i=solve%20x%5E2-5x%2B6%3D0
(paste-fallback: solve x^2-5x+6=0)
Encoding note: The encoded payload round-trips to the exact quadratic query used as the worked case.

OUTPUT FORMAT:
1. Case Blueprint — requested root types and counts
2. Coefficient Bank — accepted distinct equations
3. Discriminant Ledger — value, type and exact roots
4. Student Set — ordered original practice
5. Checked Key — substitutions and solver routes

QUALITY AND TOOL GUARDRAILS:
- Never invent Wolfram quiz slugs or Khan topic URLs.
- Use external solvers as check-this-yourself tools, not as proof that every pedagogical constraint was met.
- Label all generated equations ORIGINAL PRACTICE.
- Reject scalar multiples when they create cosmetic duplicates.
- Respect the requested real or complex course scope.
- Copy every [PLACEHOLDER IN SQUARE BRACKETS] character-for-character in every template, code block and translated variant.
- Never output a desmos.com URL with parameters, a mathsolver.microsoft.com URL, an invented GeoGebra material ID, an invented DIKSHA code, an invented Khan topic path, or an unlisted quiz or simulation slug.

   artofproblemsolving.com/community/q1_ · khanacademy.org/search?page_search_query= ·
